title: Scalar treatment cures Herrera's dog's bladder mass

tellings.quote: and they did this with my dog for example because he would like I said he was diagnosed with some sort of bladder mass that they thought was cancerous

plain: Michael Herrera, a man who says he saw a huge UFO while serving in Indonesia, says that his dog was diagnosed with a bladder mass that vets thought was cancer. He says the dog was treated with what he calls a scalar treatment, a kind of energy-based healing, and that it cleared the mass. If true, it would mean such treatments can heal disease.
